naslov: EuroLeague updates official injury report, Justin Minaya and Isaac Bonga questionable
tekst:
Crvena Zvezda Meridianbet Belgrade vs. Paris Basketball (20:00 CEST)
Crvena Zvezda
Johnathan Motley is not expected to play while Ebuka Izundu and Stefan Miljenovic are questionable for Crvena Zvezda’s game against Paris on Friday, the club has confirmed.
- Ebuka Izundu was ruled out for Round 5 with an ankle injury.
- Johnathan Motley (thigh) has been out since Round 4.
- Stefan Miljenovic, who didn’t play in Round 4, was sidelined for Round 5 with an ankle injury.
